banner.title: seerr
banner.tagline: Takes movie and series requests from the household and friends, checks Plex for what already exists, and keeps its state in Postgres.

explainer.title: A request front on Postgres, with a generated key

steps.title: Database
steps.text: seerr-db creates a role and a database on the shared postgres-18 cluster. An init container runs before Seerr starts, with the database settings from the Secret.
steps.scene: a database cylinder with a small role badge

steps.title: Key
steps.text: The Password generator makes SEERR_API_KEY once. Seerr reads it from the Secret, and PushSecret writes it to 1Password item seerr-api.
steps.scene: a generated key card moving into a vault

steps.title: Request
steps.text: seerr.${SECRET_DOMAIN} on envoy-external is the request front door, and the only one the internet reaches for this app.
steps.scene: a ticket stub passing through a glowing gate

steps.title: Scan
steps.text: Seerr reaches Plex at plex.media.svc:32400 over the in-cluster service, with its own Plex token. The CiliumNetworkPolicy admits it by name.
steps.scene: a film strip flowing into a library

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: kopiur snapshots the 2 GiB config claim to R2 each day.
steps.scene: snapshot cards flowing into a cloud bucket
